name: Rubbing of Shimen Song 石門頌 拓片
summary: The rubbing is taken from the cliff face inside a stone tunnel (also known as Shimen or the Stone Gate) on the ancient Bao-Xie Route, a precipitous plank footway linking the capital of Chang'an (now Xi'an) to the province of Sichuan.
